title: Zest Strike
one_line: A juicy free-for-all fruit shooter with a real 2x to 12x sniper scope.
how_to_play: Pick your fruit and your gun. WASD to move, mouse to look, left click to shoot, right click to aim. With the Rind Ranger sniper, right click opens the scope: scroll or press Z and X to zoom from 2x up to 12x, and hold Shift to steady your breath. G throws a juice bomb, C crouches, R reloads, Q swaps to your pistol. First to 25 squeezes wins.
description: Oranges, lemons, limes and grapefruits fight it out on a juice factory yard with a central tower, sniper perches, shipping containers and crates. Four guns plus a pistol, a sniper scope with four zoom levels, sway and a hold-breath meter, a rangefinder, scope glint that gives away enemy snipers, juice bombs, kill streaks and a minimap that shows anyone who fires.
